title: SeaRates System Release Notes: Week 48, 2024 Updates
meta_title: SeaRates Release Notes: Week 48, 2024 Platform Updates
meta_description: SeaRates Week 48 updates bring ocean container tracking improvements, air cargo API fixes, Virtual Office document controls, and new LandRates pages.
body:
### Tracking System Integrations

Updates to ocean container tracking data feeds cover fourteen global shipping lines and freight forwarders:

* CMA CGM
* DB Schenker
* SITC Container Lines
* Trans Asian Shipping Services
* Cordelia Container Shipping Line
* Heung-A Shipping
* Shipco Transport
* Wan Hai
* Mariana Express Lines (MELL)
* ECU Worldwide
* Yusen Logistics
* Grimaldi Deep Sea S.P.A.
* Sinotrans Container Lines
* Marguisa Shipping Lines

### Air Cargo Data Updates

Refinements to the air cargo tracking API data layer affect twelve air carriers:

* French Bee
* Air Caraibes
* Singapore Airlines
* Air Europa
* Hong Kong Air Cargo
* Air China Cargo
* UPS Air Cargo
* Vistara
* Vietnam Airlines
* Air Canada
* Etihad Cargo
* American Airlines

### Shipping Schedules Data Adjustments

Data processing updates for shipping schedules apply to specific provider parameters:

* By Points: ACL, MSC, Hapag-Lloyd, CMA CGM
* By Vessel: Culines

### Virtual Office Document Control

Interface layout and file permissions changed inside the Bookings tab under the Documents section. Uploaded and downloaded files default to restricted visibility, appearing exclusively to the booking owner and manager. Remaining booking participants view files only after explicit review and approval using the Show button.

### Transport Management System Navigation

Users clicking on any Transport Name within the Transport Management System list now retrieve detailed transport unit data. Selection opens the corresponding transport card within the Logistics Map tool.

### Platform Documentation and Tools

Several additions expand documentation across the logistics management platform and freight rate management tools:

* Request an IT Quote form: Added tooltips explaining Freight Index, Air Cargo Tracking, Cargo Wizard, CO2 Calculator, Demurrage and Storage Calculator, World Sea Ports, SeaRates Mobile App, SeaRates Enterprise, and Parcel Tracking.
* Quotation System API: Published a dedicated landing page.
* Knowledge Base: Added FAQ sections to Logistics Explorer and Ship Schedules.
* Find a Tool page: Added documentation links for Rail Tracking Web, Road Tracking Web, and Freight Index API.
* LandRates.com: Published new landing pages for Rail Freight Tracking and Road Freight Tracking.

### Recent Feature Rollouts

* Calendar tab within the Tracking System tool
* Updated Route Planner API version
* Freight Index 1.0 release
* SeaRates Mobile App Version 1.2 featuring the Request System
* Load Calculator Version 2.2
* Map platform update
